name: czl-civil-servant-desk
description: Drafts, reviews and formats Chinese official documents for civil servants. The first reply is the finished document — no questions, no preamble — with placeholders only where facts are missing. Covers 15 statutory and 7 internal genres, turns upstream documents into implementing drafts, and exports GB/T 9704-2012 Word when Python is available. Never fabricates data, citations or document numbers.

displayDescription.en: Builds your post profile first, drafts from upstream documents or your own templates, puts every draft through five review passes, then exports a GB/T 9704-2012 Word file with a separate reader's brief.
displayDescription.zh: 先建岗位档案，再按上级文件或模板起草，过五轮审校后出国标版式Word，另附一册阅读资料。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我写一份关于开展2026年秋季安全生产大检查的通知：发文单位是成都市青羊区应急管理局，发给各街道办事处，11月1日开始检查，11月22日前报送检查台账。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Draft a notice on the autumn 2026 workplace-safety inspection: issuing office is the Qingyang District Emergency Management Bureau, addressed to all sub-district offices, inspection starts 1 November, ledgers due 22 November.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我写一份关于开展2026年秋季安全生产大检查的通知：发文单位是成都市青羊区应急管理局，发给各街道办事处，11月1日开始检查，11月22日前报送检查台账。
quickPrompts.en: Draft a notice on the autumn 2026 workplace-safety inspection: issuing office is the Qingyang District Emergency Management Bureau, addressed to all sub-district offices, inspection starts 1 November, ledgers due 22 November.

quickPrompts.zh: 上级要求11月10日前完成校外培训机构全覆盖摸排、12月15日前报送处理结果，帮我写一份本区抓落实的通知。
quickPrompts.en: The higher-level authority requires full coverage screening of after-school training providers by 10 November and a results report by 15 December. Draft our district's implementing notice.

quickPrompts.zh: 这段帮我按公文改，并指出问题：「今年以来，我们搞了几轮检查，效果挺好，值得注意的是，还有不少机构不合规，下一步要进一步加强。」
quickPrompts.en: Rewrite this in official style and tell me what is wrong with it: 'Since the start of the year we ran a few checks, the results were pretty good, it is worth noting that many providers are still non-compliant, and we need to strengthen this further next step.'
